message: ウェイトレス

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, this isn't the price on the menu!」

name: Pasta
message: 「Quit whining about every little thing, nya. I've got no use for commoners who can't even pay chump change, nya.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I didn't even order this!」

name: Pasta
message: 「Pasta's just doing her job, nya.」

name: Pasta
message: 「If you've got a problem with it, don't bother coming back, nya.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You bet I won't! I wouldn't come back even if you begged me!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Aaargh, seriously!」

name: Synn
message: 「Something wrong?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Can't someone do something about that waitress!?」

name: Misa
message: 「Waitress--you mean the one at Prier?」

name: Ria
message: 「Pasta, right.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah! She's the absolute worst!」

name: Synn
message: 「She did seem pretty inexperienced with customer service, yeah.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That's not the problem!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「She brings out the wrong orders, she rips people off on the bill!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「And that attitude of hers, treating customers like garbage--it's totally unacceptable!」

name: Misa
message: 「From your perspective, Nanaka, I can see why that would be unforgivable.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I daresay anyone would find such behavior intolerable.」

name: Ria
message: 「I haven't heard many good rumors about her either.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I was putting up with it since Helena's the one who decided to hire her, but...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「When it goes on for days like this, even my patience hits its limit!」

name: Ria
message: 「Maybe we should talk to Big Sis about it once.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「All right, let's take it straight to her!」

name: Synn
message: 「Excuse me.」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh, welcome. What brings you all here together?」

name: Synn
message: 「Um, it's about the waitress at Prier...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Fire her, fire her!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Easy now, easy.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「If you're going to hire someone like her, I'll do it myself!」

name: Misa
message: 「I told you to calm down already.」

name: Ria
message: 「Like this, complaints from the students just keep coming in.」

name: Helena
message: 「I see...」

name: Helena
message: 「Well, that's a problem!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Why do you sound like it's someone else's problem!?」

name: Helena
message: 「I have tried warning her, for what it's worth?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「There's no sign that she's improved at all, though...」

name: Helena
message: 「I'm sure she's trying her hardest in her own way.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Even if you say that...」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, telling her to quit out of nowhere might be a bit harsh.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「She might end up out on the streets, after all.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What's that, are you saying I'm going too far!?」

name: Misa
message: 「Still, it's a fact that regular students are suffering because of it...」

name: Ria
message: 「Why don't we try talking to Pasta herself once?」

name: Synn
message: 「That might be a good idea.」

name: Helena
message: 「Very well, I approve.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Alright, let's head straight to Prier right now!!」

name: Pasta
message: 「Nyafufu...」

name: Pasta
message: 「Are preparations going smoothly for you lot, nya?」

name: Cat Demon
message: 「Meow!」

name: Pasta
message: 「I see, nya. Keep up the good work, nya.」

name: Pasta
message: 「For Bylous-nyama-nya's sake, we have to lure out the Demon Lord quickly, nya!」

name: Pasta
message: 「And while you're at it, don't forget to take care of those pesky Crusaders, nya.」

name: Cat Demon
message: 「Meow!」

name: Pasta
message: 「Ahh, Bylous-nyama-nya...」

name: Pasta
message: 「Pasta will definitely make Bylous-nyama-nya's wish come true, nyan.\s04」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Open up!」

name: Pasta
message: 「Nyah-what!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Excuse me, is Pasta here.」

name: Pasta
message: 「W-What do you people want, nya!」

name: Helena
message: 「Pardon the intrusion~」

name: Pasta
message: 「Urgh! The Chairwoman, nya!?」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh my, could it be you're in the middle of something?」

name: Cat Demon
message: 「Meow.」

name: Ria
message: 「I-Is that!」

name: Misa
message: 「A Demon!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Which means...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Miss Waitress was in league with the Demons!」

name: Pasta
message: 「Nyauuu... What terrible timing you guys have, nya...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I thought she was suspicious for a while now, and I knew it!」

name: Synn
message: 「That was just you jumping to conclusions, Nanaka.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Anyway, there's no doubt she was plotting something evil!」

name: Helena
message: 「So she's finally shown her true colors, hasn't she.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Helena
message: 「I knew Pasta-chan was plotting something.」

name: Ria
message: 「So you were letting her run loose on purpose?」

name: Helena
message: 「Yep. I was planning to keep doing that until her goal became clear, but...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Her goal is plain as day!」

name: Misa
message: 「You meant to turn against us from the very beginning!」

name: Pasta
message: 「Nyafu! Now that the cat's out of the bag, there's no helping it, nya!」

name: Pasta
message: 「Pasta herself will make you feel the might of the Seven Demon Generals, nya!」

name: Ria
message: 「So she was a Demon General...」

name: Pasta
message: 「It's time for a bloodbath, nyaaa!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn, let's go!」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah!」

name: Helena
message: 「I'll lend a hand too!」
